usage: 凍菊花茶 is a noun used to refer to a cold beverage made from chrysanthemum flowers.
You can use 凍菊花茶 to order this drink in restaurants or cafes in Hong Kong.
凍菊花茶 can be combined with other food or drink items when making a sentence.
It is common to use 凍菊花茶 in daily conversation when talking about drinks, especially in hot weather.
